attributes.title: 2027 NCNA Psych Retreat
attributes.venue: Embassy Suites by Hilton Raleigh Crabtree
attributes.summary:
The North Carolina Nurses Association holds its 2027 Psych Retreat on February 5 and 6, 2027, at the Embassy Suites by Hilton Raleigh Crabtree. It covers current practice and policy in psychiatric-mental health nursing and is open to RNs, APRNs, point-of-care nurses and students; a short preconference on February 5 focuses on psychopharmacology.

NCNA, an ANCC-accredited provider, lists up to 12.0 contact hours, including up to 2.75 pharmacotherapeutic hours. Topics on the agenda include harm reduction, perinatal mood disorders, ECT, GLP-1 drugs in mental health and safer milieu management.

Early-bird rates run until December 18, 2026: $357 for members and $534 for guests for the full program. Regular rates are $447 and $671, and pre-registration ends January 29, 2027. The hotel block ($179–$189 a night) is held until January 15, 2027.
